name: Shambhu Nath Pal
contribution: A local organizer associated with the Pabna peasant mobilization.
context: He appears in accounts of the movement’s organized rural resistance and rent-agitation networks.
impact: His profile helps show that agrarian politics in colonial Bengal depended on local organizers as well as formal law.
